Buenaventura Durruti.question: Between activism and his job, he was rarely able to see _____

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At the third congress of the CNT, hosted in Madrid, Durruti welcomed Rudolf Rocker, the secretary of the International Workers' Association (IWA), and discussed the political changes in Spain with him.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: At the welcome rally at the _____ of Communications, Rocker was overwhelmed by the more than 15,000 attendees
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At the welcome rally at the Palace of Communications, Rocker was overwhelmed by the more than 15,000 attendees.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti took a leading role in the strike and began to reorganise his old affinity group into a new one, which they named Nosotros.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: During the strike, Durruti spoke before popular assemblys at the Palau de les Belles Arts and the Plaça de Catalunya.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He condemned the labour minister _____ for continuing the practice of mandatory labour arbitration, which he considered to be inherently biased towards employers
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He condemned the labour minister Francisco Largo Caballero for continuing the practice of mandatory labour arbitration, which he considered to be inherently biased towards employers.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti's mother then pressed his sister Rosa to travel to _____ and visit him
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti's mother then pressed his sister Rosa to travel to Barcelona and visit him.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: She reported that Durruti and _____ lived in squalid conditions with few possessions; Morin, who was pregnant at the time, slept on an empty bed base without a mattress
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: She reported that Durruti and Morin lived in squalid conditions with few possessions; Morin, who was pregnant at the time, slept on an empty bed base without a mattress. When Rosa chided her brother for not having told his family about his living situation and said they could have bought a mattress for Morin, he shrugged it off, saying Morin's pregnancy was going well.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: It was only when _____ de Guzmán, editor of the independent anarchist newspaper La Tierra, approached Durruti for comment that his thoughts on the matter were publicised
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: It was only when Eduardo de Guzmán, editor of the independent anarchist newspaper La Tierra, approached Durruti for comment that his thoughts on the matter were publicised.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti was later expelled from the _____' Union, after he accused the signatory Ricard Fornells of collaborating with political parties, without evidence
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti was later expelled from the Food Workers' Union, after he accused the signatory Ricard Fornells of collaborating with political parties, without evidence.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The publication of the manifesto coincided with increased political repression against the CNT, as well as criticisms of the organisation by the _____ and PCE
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The publication of the manifesto coincided with increased political repression against the CNT, as well as criticisms of the organisation by the PSOE and PCE.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There he was also informed by his sister that the Official Bulletin of Asturias (BOA) had printed an order to arrest him for the _____ Gijón bank heist, and that police had searched her home in León,
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: There he was also informed by his sister that the Official Bulletin of Asturias (BOA) had printed an order to arrest him for the 1923 Gijón bank heist, and that police had searched her home in León, looking for him.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The Spanish press branded Durruti, Ascaso and Joan Garcia Oliver as "public enemies", culminating with Ascaso's arrest in October _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Spanish press branded Durruti, Ascaso and Joan Garcia Oliver as "public enemies", culminating with Ascaso's arrest in October 1931.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Less than a week after he sent this letter, on 4 December _____, Emilienne Morin gave birth to their daughter Colette Durruti
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Less than a week after he sent this letter, on 4 December 1931, Emilienne Morin gave birth to their daughter Colette Durruti.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: A few days later, he went to _____ to speak at a rally and was arrested when he arrived at the railway station
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: A few days later, he went to Girona to speak at a rally and was arrested when he arrived at the railway station.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Although he was charged for his attempt against _____ XIII in Paris, Durruti believed he had been arrested to prevent him from speaking at the rally
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Although he was charged for his attempt against Alfonso XIII in Paris, Durruti believed he had been arrested to prevent him from speaking at the rally. When he finally spoke at the rally, Durruti declared that his arrest for attempting to assassinate Alfonso XIII proved that Spain was still effectively ruled as a monarchy.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: When he finally spoke at the rally, Durruti declared that his arrest for attempting to assassinate _____ XIII proved that Spain was still effectively ruled as a monarchy
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Although he was charged for his attempt against Alfonso XIII in Paris, Durruti believed he had been arrested to prevent him from speaking at the rally. Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti, along with Morin and their daughter, finally returned to León for the first time in _____ years
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti, along with Morin and their daughter, finally returned to León for the first time in 14 years.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: His father died before he made it there; _____'s funeral was co-organised by the UGT and CNT, who hoped to pay tribute to him and express support for his son
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: His father died before he made it there; Santiago Durruti's funeral was co-organised by the UGT and CNT, who hoped to pay tribute to him and express support for his son.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: To prevent this, the Civil Guard arrested Durruti under investigation for the _____ Gijón robbery
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: To prevent this, the Civil Guard arrested Durruti under investigation for the 1923 Gijón robbery.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti told the police chief that the money from the heist had been spent on bringing about the _____ and warned that, if he did not speak at the rally, the city would face an uprising
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti told the police chief that the money from the heist had been spent on bringing about the Republic and warned that, if he did not speak at the rally, the city would face an uprising. He declared that the Republic had failed to solve Spain's social and political issues and proclaimed that a social revolution against the existing order was inevitable; in order to bring about the revolution, he called for the working class to unite.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti addressed the rally the following day, speaking before workers that had come from León, _____, Galicia and Castile
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti addressed the rally the following day, speaking before workers that had come from León, Asturias, Galicia and Castile.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At a rally in _____, he called for workers to rise up in revolution, expropriate the capitalists and overthrow the state
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At a rally in Sallent, he called for workers to rise up in revolution, expropriate the capitalists and overthrow the state.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 18 January _____, insurrection broke out in the region, as workers armed themselves and proclaimed libertarian communism
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 18 January 1932, insurrection broke out in the region, as workers armed themselves and proclaimed libertarian communism.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti was arrested for his part in the insurrection, on 21 _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 18 January 1932, insurrection broke out in the region, as workers armed themselves and proclaimed libertarian communism. Durruti was arrested for his part in the insurrection, on 21 January.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He was among the 110 anarchist militants who were packed onto the _____ steamship, where they were sentenced without trial to deportation
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He was among the 110 anarchist militants who were packed onto the Buenos Aires steamship, where they were sentenced without trial to deportation.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: When Durruti and _____ started a hunger strike, they were separated from the other detainees
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When Durruti and Ascaso started a hunger strike, they were separated from the other detainees.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On the morning of 10 _____, the ship left mainland Spain in the direction of Spanish Guinea
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On the morning of 10 February, the ship left mainland Spain in the direction of Spanish Guinea.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: On the way to _____, the deportees were crammed into the cargo hold below deck
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On the way to Africa, the deportees were crammed into the cargo hold below deck.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The ship then rerouted to the _____ to drop off the sick, before heading to Río de Oro
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The ship then rerouted to the Canary Islands to drop off the sick, before heading to Río de Oro.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: However, the military governor Ramón _____, the son of Fernando González Regueral, refused to accept the deportees if Durruti was among them
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: However, the military governor Ramón Regueral Jove, the son of Fernando González Regueral, refused to accept the deportees if Durruti was among them.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After consulting with _____é Giral, the ship returned to Fuerteventura, where it dropped off Durruti and a number of other deportees
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After consulting with Navy Minister José Giral, the ship returned to Fuerteventura, where it dropped off Durruti and a number of other deportees.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There, Durruti was imprisoned there at _____ de Cabras, where he contracted malaria and developed a hernia
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: There, Durruti was imprisoned there at Puerto de Cabras, where he contracted malaria and developed a hernia.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Upon arriving in the Canarian island in April _____, he received letters from Morin, as well as other friends and family
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Upon arriving in the Canarian island in April 1932, he received letters from Morin, as well as other friends and family.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He reassured them that he was in good health before describing the squalid conditions on _____, where he lived in a barracks on an allowance of 1.75 pesetas per day
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He reassured them that he was in good health before describing the squalid conditions on Fuerteventura, where he lived in a barracks on an allowance of 1.75 pesetas per day.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: According to an acquaintance of Durruti, he lived an "orderly and contemplative life" in _____, where he spent most of his time reading books, frequenting the breakwater
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: According to an acquaintance of Durruti, he lived an "orderly and contemplative life" in Fuerteventura, where he spent most of his time reading books, frequenting the breakwater.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In mainland _____, social conflict was progressively escalating even without the presence of the "provocateur" Durruti, with strike actions, occupations and violent attacks becoming commonplace
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In mainland Spain, social conflict was progressively escalating even without the presence of the "provocateur" Durruti, with strike actions, occupations and violent attacks becoming commonplace.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: As the government attempted to crack down on the labour movement's activities, in August 1932, right-wing forces led by General José Sanjurjo attempted a coup, but a general strike by the CNT defeated the attempt. Buenaventura Durruti.question: By the time Durruti arrived back in Barcelona in September _____, Catalonia had been granted a statue of autonomy and the CNT had definitively split, with its moderate and revolutionary factions falli
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: As the government attempted to crack down on the labour movement's activities, in August 1932, right-wing forces led by General José Sanjurjo attempted a coup, but a general strike by the CNT defeated the attempt. By the time Durruti arrived back in Barcelona in September 1932, Catalonia had been granted a statue of autonomy and the CNT had definitively split, with its moderate and revolutionary factions falling into open conflict.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The coup plotters were exiled to the _____ colonies, forcing the government to allow the deported anarchists to return
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The coup plotters were exiled to the African colonies, forcing the government to allow the deported anarchists to return.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti was one of the last anarchists that was permitted to leave the _____, from which he was taken directly to Barcelona by steamship
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti was one of the last anarchists that was permitted to leave the Canary Islands, from which he was taken directly to Barcelona by steamship.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After arriving, he immediately returned to his family, finding that _____ had struggled to financially support their daughter in his absence
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After arriving, he immediately returned to his family, finding that Morin had struggled to financially support their daughter in his absence.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Turning to his deportation, he said that the government had failed in its objectives to isolate him, as it had enabled him to spread anarchist propaganda in the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Turning to his deportation, he said that the government had failed in its objectives to isolate him, as it had enabled him to spread anarchist propaganda in the Canary Islands.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: The following week, on 23 _____, Durruti was arrested and held incommunicado at the Police Prefecture on Via Laietana
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The following week, on 23 September, Durruti was arrested and held incommunicado at the Police Prefecture on Via Laietana.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After he was released in early December _____, Durruti quickly returned to his job at the textile factory; Morin herself worried about when he would next be incarcerated
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After he was released in early December 1932, Durruti quickly returned to his job at the textile factory; Morin herself worried about when he would next be incarcerated.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Three days after he was released, Durruti and other members of Nosotros gathered at _____'s house to discuss plans for another insurrection
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Three days after he was released, Durruti and other members of Nosotros gathered at Joan Garcia Oliver's house to discuss plans for another insurrection.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At the meeting, Durruti expressed regret that the CNT had wasted time on internal debates, while the state had strengthened itself with a new, well-equipped police force, the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At the meeting, Durruti expressed regret that the CNT had wasted time on internal debates, while the state had strengthened itself with a new, well-equipped police force, the Assault Guard.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The group resolved to bring about a social revolution and established a revolutionary committee, on which Durruti served as the official representative of the CNT's _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The group resolved to bring about a social revolution and set up a revolutionary committee, on which Durruti served as the official representative of the CNT's National Committee.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti was dispatched to Cádiz, where he met with the _____ and discussed the planned insurrection
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti was dispatched to Cádiz, where he met with the Andalusian Regional Confederation and discussed the planned insurrection.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: When the insurrection broke out on the evening of 8 January _____, Durruti led the assault against the Travessera de Gràcia barracks, where he found that the police had already mobilised
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When the insurrection broke out on the evening of 8 January 1933, Durruti led the assault against the Travessera de Gràcia barracks, where he found that the police had already mobilised.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The insurrection broke out on 8 December _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When the insurrection broke out on the evening of 8 January 1933, Durruti led the assault against the Travessera de Gràcia barracks, where he found that the police had already mobilised.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: By the early hours of 9 _____, the insurrection had failed

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: As public criticism of the insurrection soon followed, in the newspaper _____, Durruti attempted to defend his actions as a necessary effort to prevent the government from consolidating power
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: As public criticism of the insurrection soon followed, in the newspaper La Voz Confederal, Durruti attempted to defend his actions as a necessary effort to prevent the government from consolidating power.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He rejected accusations that the insurgents had attempted to take power and establish a dictatorship, denied that they were _____ and Trotskyists, and reaffirmed his conviction to continue
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He rejected accusations that the insurgents had attempted to take power and establish a dictatorship, denied that they were Blanquists and Trotskyists, and reaffirmed his conviction to continue.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In late March _____, the CNT dispatched Durruti and Ascaso to speak at a rally in Seville
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In late March 1933, the CNT dispatched Durruti and Ascaso to speak at a rally in Seville.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Throughout Andalusia and _____, local unions planned rallies when they found out that the two would be coming
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Throughout Andalusia and Extremadura, local unions planned rallies when they found out that the two would be coming.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After arriving and speaking at the rally, on 8 _____, as they were planning a speaking tour of the province, they were arrested on charges of "insults to authority" and "incitement to rebellion"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After arriving and speaking at the rally, on 8 April, as they were planning a speaking tour of the province, they were arrested on charges of "insults to authority" and "incitement to rebellion".

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Madrid newspaper La Voz claimed that Durruti had been arrested because he was planning another insurrection in Andalusia.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti was visited in prison by the writer Pío _____, who portrayed him as a romantic hero and described him as an "incarnation of the Spanish guerrilla"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti was visited in prison by the writer Pío Baroja, who portrayed him as a romantic hero and described him as an "incarnation of the Spanish guerrilla".

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In contrast, _____ denounced Durruti as an "idler and delinquent"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In contrast, Interior Minister Santiago Casares Quiroga denounced Durruti as an "idler and delinquent".

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti and _____ were incarcerated in El Puerto de Santa María prison for six months
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti and Ascaso were incarcerated in El Puerto de Santa María prison for six months.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Nevertheless, he was able to smuggle some of his letters out to the CNT and _____ newspapers, in which he publicised the conditions he was being held in
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Nevertheless, he was able to smuggle some of his letters out to the CNT and El Luchador newspapers, in which he publicised the conditions he was being held in.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In June, he smuggled out a letter to _____, in which he reported that the authorities had kept visitors from seeing him
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In June, he smuggled out a letter to Morin, in which he reported that the authorities had kept visitors from seeing him.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In September, the government attempted to apply anti-vagrancy laws against Durruti and Ascaso, despite neither being unemployed, which provoked them to begin their hunger strike.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After eight days of hunger strike, on 5 October _____, Durruti and his fellow inmates were released
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 14 July 1933, Durruti sent a letter to his family, telling them of how, after the guards murdered a prisoner, he de-escalated an impending prison riot when he noticed the guards had machine guns pointed at them; he believed they intended to provoke a massacre. Buenaventura Durruti.question: Two days later, he arrived at the CNT newspaper offices in _____, then the following day, he finally returned to Barcelona

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Growing unemployment in _____ directly affected Durruti, who was unable to find a job at his former factory
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Growing unemployment in Spain directly affected Durruti, who was unable to find a job at his former factory.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: He signed up to the job pool of the CNT _____' Union, which managed to find him and two other unemployed workers mechanical jobs at a large workshop
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He signed up to the job pool of the CNT Metalworkers' Union, which managed to find him and two other unemployed workers mechanical jobs at a large workshop.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: The two viewed right-wing newspapers, such as _____, as part of the problem, due to their publication of sensationalist pieces about robberies by suspected anarchists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The two viewed right-wing newspapers, such as La Vanguardia, as part of the problem, due to their publication of sensationalist pieces about robberies by suspected anarchists. Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti convened a _____ (NRC), which was to organise the insurrection
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti convened a National Revolutionary Committee (NRC), which was to organise the insurrection.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He and his supporters began a campaign to agitate workers in _____ for another insurrection
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He and his supporters began a campaign to agitate workers in Barcelona for another insurrection.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: By the following day, a social revolution had swept _____, confirming Durruti's prediction that workers would respond to a right-wing coup with revolution
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: By the following day, a social revolution had swept Catalonia, confirming Durruti's prediction that workers would respond to a right-wing coup with revolution.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti warned one worker that they had not yet won, that the revolution would still be in progress until they defeated every remaining rebel soldier throughout _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti warned one worker that they had not yet won, that the revolution would still be in progress until they defeated every remaining rebel soldier throughout Spain.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti and _____ went to the Palace of the Generalitat and met with the Catalan President
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They made their way to the Casa Cambó on Via Laietana, where the CNT Regional Secretary Mariano R. Vázquez informed Durruti and Garcia Oliver that President Lluis Companys had requested a meeting with them. Durruti and Garcia Oliver went to the Palace of the Generalitat and met with the Catalan President.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti deferred the anarchist seizure of power until after _____ was liberated from the Nationalists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti deferred the anarchist seizure of power until after Zaragoza was liberated from the Nationalists.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti attended the inaugural meeting of the _____ as one of the representatives for the CNT
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After meeting with Companys and the representatives of other anti-fascist parties, the anarchists moved to establish the Central Committee of Antifascist Militias of Catalonia (CCMA), which would oversee the organisation of militias to fight against the Nationalist forces. At the plenary meeting of the CNT which set up the CCMA, Garcia Oliver attempted to push for the anarchists to seize power, but his motion was defeated by advocates of collaboration with other anti-fascist political groupings.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At the meeting, Durruti confronted the Catalan nationalist _____ over an article he had written comparing the FAI to fascists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At the meeting, Durruti confronted the Catalan nationalist Jaume Miravitlles over an article he had written comparing the FAI to fascists.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The meeting appointed Durruti as an assistant to _____, who himself was appointed to oversee the Department of War; Durruti was selected to head the transportation department
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The meeting appointed Durruti as an assistant to Garcia Oliver, who himself was appointed to oversee the Department of War; Durruti was selected to head the transportation department. When the meeting concluded, Durruti and Garcia Oliver told the Stalinist politician Joan Comorera that they remembered how the Bolsheviks had repressed anarchism in Russia and that they would not allow the Spanish Communists to treat them the same way.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Over the subsequent days, Durruti quickly came to regard the _____ as a bureaucratic organisation, which he did not want to continue participating in
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Over the subsequent days, Durruti quickly came to regard the CCMA as a bureaucratic organisation, which he did not want to continue participating in. He was then replaced on the CCMA by Marcos Alcón.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Seeking to continue the fight against the Nationalists, he put together the first militia column: the self-titled _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Seeking to continue the fight against the Nationalists, he put together the first militia column: the self-titled Durruti Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He was then replaced on the CCMA by _____ón
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He was then replaced on the CCMA by Marcos Alcón.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti clashed with his military adviser, _____ Pérez Farràs, over this form of military organisation, which Pérez Farràs believed would not function in battle
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti clashed with his military adviser, Enric Pérez Farràs, over this form of military organisation, which Pérez Farràs believed would not function in battle.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He later ended up replacing Pérez Farràs with José _____, a non-commissioned officer who better understood Durruti's anti-authoritarian philosophy
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He later ended up replacing Pérez Farràs with José Manzana, a non-commissioned officer who better understood Durruti's anti-authoritarian philosophy.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 08:00 on 24 July _____, Durruti spoke over the radio to Barcelona's workers, asking them to supply his column with food
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 08:00 on 24 July 1936, Durruti spoke over the radio to Barcelona's workers, asking them to supply his column with food.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The Canadian journalist _____ van Paassen reported meeting with Durruti that morning
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Canadian journalist Pierre van Paassen reported meeting with Durruti that morning.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: "We want the revolution here in Spain, right now," he said, "not perhaps tomorrow after the next _____ war"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: "We want the revolution here in Spain, right now," he said, "not perhaps tomorrow after the next European war".

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: It is we who built these palaces and cities, here in Spain and in _____ and everywhere
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: It is we who built these palaces and cities, here in Spain and in America and everywhere.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 10:00, large crowds gathered on the Passeig de Gràcia to bid farewell to the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 10:00, large crowds gathered on the Passeig de Gràcia to bid farewell to the Durruti Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They quickly captured Casp and _____, the latter of which the Column established as its headquarters
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to _____, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They then set off towards _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They then set off towards Zaragoza.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 28 July, the _____ came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There he was reunited with his partner Émilienne Morin, with whom he organised the administrative apparatus of the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He also got into an argument with Pérez Farràs, who tried to use the ambush as justification for the restructuring of the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: From the _____ town hall, Durruti gave a rousing speech to the Column
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: From the Burcharaloz town hall, Durruti gave a rousing speech to the Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He chided them for running from the airplanes, pointing out that they had promised to take _____ or die trying
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He chided them for running from the airplanes, pointing out that they had promised to take Zaragoza or die trying.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He reminded them of the peasants who were building libertarian communism in their rear, and that their efforts would be for naught if the _____ were victorious
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He reminded them of the peasants who were building libertarian communism in their rear, and that their efforts would be for naught if the Nationalists were victorious.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: While recognising the dangers they faced, he called on them to take advantage of their victory in _____ to strike quickly against their enemies
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: While recognising the dangers they faced, he called on them to take advantage of their victory in Barcelona to strike quickly against their enemies.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He welcomed anyone that did not want to continue fighting to give up their rifle to someone more willing, while encouraging those that remained to continue on to _____ and Iruña
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He welcomed anyone that did not want to continue fighting to give up their rifle to someone more willing, while encouraging those that remained to continue on to Zaragoza and Iruña.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The Durruti Column then advanced along the Ebro river towards Zaragoza, but they were halted by Nationalist resistance some _____ outside the city, forcing them to dig in
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Durruti Column then advanced along the Ebro river towards Zaragoza, but they were halted by Nationalist resistance some 20 kilometers outside the city, forcing them to dig in.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After consulting with _____é Villalba Rubio, Durruti agreed to keep his Column in place until reinforcements arrived
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After consulting with Colonel José Villalba Rubio, Durruti agreed to keep his Column in place until reinforcements arrived.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There was little movement on the front lines in early _____, which made Durruti impatient
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: There was little movement on the front lines in early August, which made Durruti impatient.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Members of the collectives had been complaining to him about a lack of technical personnel and that some of their workers had left the collectives to join the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He expelled them from the Column and the CNT, then when they did not respond to his reprimands as he had expected, he stripped them of their clothes and sent them back to Barcelona in only their underwear. Members of the collectives had been complaining to him about a lack of technical personnel and that some of their workers had left the collectives to join the Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti sought to the wage war against the _____ and advance the revolution at the tsame time
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti sought to the wage war against the Nationalists and advance the revolution at the tsame time.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Seeking to break the stalemate, Durruti returned to _____ and speak with the CCMA
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On the former issue, he demanded that Ricardo Sanz send them agronomists from Barcelona; of the latter, he dismissed them from the Column so that they could return to work on the collectives, telling them it was more important to the revolution. Seeking to break the stalemate, Durruti returned to Barcelona and speak with the CCMA.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At one checkpoint in Cervià de les _____, he posed as a rank-and-file militiaman transferring to the rearguard and requested fuel for his vehicle
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At one checkpoint in Cervià de les Garrigues, he posed as a rank-and-file militiaman transferring to the rearguard and requested fuel for his vehicle.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He then went to the CCMA headquarters on the Pla de Palau and met with _____, who he found to be stressed and sleep deprived
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He then went to the CCMA headquarters on the Pla de Palau and met with Garcia Oliver, who he found to be stressed and sleep deprived. But then Garcia Oliver informed Durruti that the Zaragoza offensive would have to be postponed in favour of the planned Mallorca landings, which they hoped would provoke a confrontation between the British and Italians.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Together they discussed the situation in Aragon, including the slated offensive to take _____, the supply shortages and the restructuring of their war committee
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Together they discussed the situation in Aragon, including the slated offensive to take Zaragoza, the supply shortages and the restructuring of their war committee. But then Garcia Oliver informed Durruti that the Zaragoza offensive would have to be postponed in favour of the planned Mallorca landings, which they hoped would provoke a confrontation between the British and Italians.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti believed that _____ and the United Kingdom would continue to uphold appeasement rather than confront the Italians
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti believed that France and the United Kingdom would continue to uphold appeasement rather than confront the Italians.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Worrying that this would result in an armed conflict between the workers and the _____ government, Durruti called a regional meeting of the CNT
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti argued that the legalisation of their revolutionary activities would only strengthen the Catalan government and weaken the CCMA, which he believed would lead them towards a form of state socialism. Worrying that this would result in an armed conflict between the workers and the Catalan government, Durruti called a regional meeting of the CNT.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti left _____ and returned to Aragon, seeking to hold his position, strengthen the confederal militias and continue advancing the revolution
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti left Barcelona and returned to Aragon, seeking to hold his position, strengthen the confederal militias and continue advancing the revolution.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti defended the anarchist structure of his militia column, despite _____'s insistence on the need for militarisation in order to increase efficiency
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti defended the anarchist structure of his militia column, despite De Traversary's insistence on the need for militarisation in order to increase efficiency.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The following day, the _____ journalist Mikhail Koltsov arrived in Burcharaloz to interview Durruti
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The following day, the Soviet journalist Mikhail Koltsov arrived in Burcharaloz to interview Durruti. He asked Koltsov what the Soviet Union planned to do to aid the Spanish revolution; the journalist responded that the Soviet government could not intervene directly, due to diplomatic issues, but that their trade unions had organised a support campaign which raised money for José Giral's government.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: When the two met, Durruti was busy issuing orders, only stopping once he noticed Koltsov had a letter from _____ identifying him as a journalist for Pravda
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When the two met, Durruti was busy issuing orders, only stopping once he noticed Koltsov had a letter from Garcia Oliver identifying him as a journalist for Pravda.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He then told _____ it was his responsibility to better inform Soviet workers of the nature of the Spanish revolution
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When the two met, Durruti was busy issuing orders, only stopping once he noticed Koltsov had a letter from Garcia Oliver identifying him as a journalist for Pravda. He asked Koltsov what the Soviet Union planned to do to aid the Spanish revolution; the journalist responded that the Soviet government could not intervene directly, due to diplomatic issues, but that their trade unions had organised a support campaign which raised money for José Giral's government.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Koltsov omitted this part of the exchange from his _____, in order to abide by the Bolshevik party line on anarchists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Koltsov omitted this part of the exchange from his Spanish Diary, in order to abide by the Bolshevik party line on anarchists.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He said that once their positions in Uesca and Teruel had improved, they would attack _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When Koltsov asked him about the military situation, Durruti responded that he thought the Republicans should focus all their strength on taking Zaragoza and lamented that their forces were dispersed across other areas. He said that once their positions in Uesca and Teruel had improved, they would attack Zaragoza.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After the battle, _____ interviewed Durruti for La Montagne; Durruti complained about Léon Blum's policy of non-interventionism, which he logically understood but philosophically could not abide
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Following the encounters with De Traversay and Koltsov, Durruti met with the French journalist Albert Souillon and the Argentine José Gabriel, both of whom wanted to witness the upcoming attack on Fuents d'Ebro. After the battle, Souillon interviewed Durruti for La Montagne; Durruti complained about Léon Blum's policy of non-interventionism, which he logically understood but philosophically could not abide.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He requested that _____ write that the Spanish were fighting for the French people, as much as for themselves, and that they needed planes if they were to beat the fascists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Following the encounters with De Traversay and Koltsov, Durruti met with the French journalist Albert Souillon and the Argentine José Gabriel, both of whom wanted to witness the upcoming attack on Fuents d'Ebro. After the battle, Souillon interviewed Durruti for La Montagne; Durruti complained about Léon Blum's policy of non-interventionism, which he logically understood but philosophically could not abide.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In early-September _____, José Villalba launched an offensive to recapture the town of Sietemo, which caused friction with Durruti, as Villalba had refused to coordinate with other militia columns at
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In early-September 1936, José Villalba launched an offensive to recapture the town of Sietemo, which caused friction with Durruti, as Villalba had refused to coordinate with other militia columns at their War Committee in Sarinyena.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At a meeting of the CCMA, Durruti confronted _____, blaming him for the Republican loss of Sietemo the previous month
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In early-September 1936, José Villalba launched an offensive to recapture the town of Sietemo, which caused friction with Durruti, as Villalba had refused to coordinate with other militia columns at their War Committee in Sarinyena. At a meeting of the CCMA, Durruti confronted Villalba, blaming him for the Republican loss of Sietemo the previous month.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Despite their differences, Durruti agreed to aid _____'s offensive and led his Column in the capture of Sietemo, Loporzano and the Castle of Montearagón, clearing the way to Uesca city
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In early-September 1936, José Villalba launched an offensive to recapture the town of Sietemo, which caused friction with Durruti, as Villalba had refused to coordinate with other militia columns at their War Committee in Sarinyena. At a meeting of the CCMA, Durruti confronted Villalba, blaming him for the Republican loss of Sietemo the previous month.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The CCMA then tasked Durruti with addressing _____ workers over the radio and informing them of the Republican victory on the Uesca front
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The CCMA then tasked Durruti with addressing Spanish workers over the radio and informing them of the Republican victory on the Uesca front.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He then addressed workers in the _____ zone, calling on them to sabotage the Nationalists' military industry and form guerrilla cells to fight them behind their lines
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He then addressed workers in the Nationalist zone, calling on them to sabotage the Nationalists' military industry and form guerrilla cells to fight them behind their lines.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He ended his speech by calling all _____ workers to have courage, declaring: "Comrades, we should be hopeful
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He ended his speech by calling all Spanish workers to have courage, declaring: "Comrades, we should be hopeful.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He briefly met with the originator of the plan, the French syndicalist leader _____, who spoke highly of Durruti
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He briefly met with the originator of the plan, the French syndicalist leader Pierre Besnard, who spoke highly of Durruti.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Besnard said he was the only _____ revolutionary leader who had "escaped degradation", as he fought with the rank-and-file on the front lines, and compared him positively with Nestor Makhno
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Besnard said he was the only Spanish revolutionary leader who had "escaped degradation", as he fought with the rank-and-file on the front lines, and compared him positively with Nestor Makhno.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti requested that _____ contact a munitions dealer to supply his Column with weaponry, before he was himself recalled to the front lines to aid in a Republican offensive
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He briefly met with the originator of the plan, the French syndicalist leader Pierre Besnard, who spoke highly of Durruti. Besnard said he was the only Spanish revolutionary leader who had "escaped degradation", as he fought with the rank-and-file on the front lines, and compared him positively with Nestor Makhno.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti and _____ pressed Catalan prime minister Josep Tarradellas to buy the weapons from Besnard's contact, but he was discouraged from doing so by Garcia Oliver
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He briefly met with the originator of the plan, the French syndicalist leader Pierre Besnard, who spoke highly of Durruti. Besnard said he was the only Spanish revolutionary leader who had "escaped degradation", as he fought with the rank-and-file on the front lines, and compared him positively with Nestor Makhno.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Negotiations between the MAC and the _____ government ultimately broke down, following pressure from the French government, which opposed any plan for Moroccan independence
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Negotiations between the MAC and the Spanish Republican government ultimately broke down, following pressure from the French government, which opposed any plan for Moroccan independence.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 26 _____, the CCMA was dissolved, which incentivised Durruti to continue making revolutionary advances in order to counter what he saw as a mounting counterrevolution
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 26 September, the CCMA was dissolved, which incentivised Durruti to continue making revolutionary advances in order to counter what he saw as a mounting counterrevolution. When Durruti arrived back in Barcelona on the night of 28–29 September, Garcia Oliver and Abad de Santillán requested that Durruti go with Besnard to Madrid to propose that Largo Caballero's government purchase the weapons.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Two days later, _____ informed him that Besnard had secured them with an arms dealer
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti and Besnard pressed Catalan prime minister Josep Tarradellas to buy the weapons from Besnard's contact, but he was discouraged from doing so by Garcia Oliver. Two days later, Garcia Oliver informed him that Besnard had secured them with an arms dealer.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti and _____án then discussed the idea of robbing the Bank of Spain and using the money from it to either purchase weapons or machines and materials with which to build a military industry
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When Durruti arrived back in Barcelona on the night of 28–29 September, Garcia Oliver and Abad de Santillán requested that Durruti go with Besnard to Madrid to propose that Largo Caballero's government purchase the weapons. Durruti and Santillán then discussed the idea of robbing the Bank of Spain and using the money from it to either purchase weapons or machines and materials with which to build a military industry.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They contacted the 3,000 militiamen of the Land and _____, stationed in Madrid, and arranged the transport of the stolen gold by train to Catalonia
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They contacted the 3,000 militiamen of the Land and Freedom Column, stationed in Madrid, and arranged the transport of the stolen gold by train to Catalonia.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Later that night, Durruti met André _____, who agreed to put him on a flight to Madrid, despite him lacking an official pass
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Later that night, Durruti met André Malraux, who agreed to put him on a flight to Madrid, despite him lacking an official pass.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: But after discussing the planned robbery with the CNT _____, which expressed worry that it would increase animosity towards Revolutionary Catalonia, Durruti and Santillán dropped the plan
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: But after discussing the planned robbery with the CNT National Committee, which expressed worry that it would increase animosity towards Revolutionary Catalonia, Durruti and Santillán dropped the plan.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They instead went ahead with the meeting with _____, who agreed to move forward with the weapons purchase negotiated by Besnard
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They instead went ahead with the meeting with Largo Caballero, who agreed to move forward with the weapons purchase negotiated by Besnard.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 3 _____, they met in the Navy Ministry and drew up a list of items to purchase
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 3 October, they met in the Navy Ministry and drew up a list of items to purchase. At 03:00 on 4 October, the Soviet ambassador called Durruti and demanded they meet immediately, but Durruti declined and returned Barcelona.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 03:00 on 4 _____, the Soviet ambassador called Durruti and demanded they meet immediately, but Durruti declined and returned Barcelona
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 3 October, they met in the Navy Ministry and drew up a list of items to purchase. At 03:00 on 4 October, the Soviet ambassador called Durruti and demanded they meet immediately, but Durruti declined and returned Barcelona.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Two days later, the CNT newspaper published an interview with Durruti from his time in _____
